verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder that can add a backend and publish apps, so a sandbox or staging environment isolated from production data is a fair question for it. The evidence documents a backend for storing data, a preview, code review and version history. None of it describes a separate sandbox or test environment, or any isolation of test runs from production data. Version history and code review are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
